DEFINITIONS A hyperbola is the set of points in a plane whose distances from two fixed points in the plane have a constant difference. The two fixed points are the foci of the hyperbola.

The line through the foci of a hyperbola is the focal axis. The point on the axis halfway between the foci is the hyperbola’s center. The points where the focal axis and hyperbola cross are the vertices (Figure 11.43).
